subject: Iceland real policy rate

latest.source: Derived: BIS WS_CBPOL policy rate less IMF WEO April 2025 inflation
latest.comparability_note: Policy rate less the annual inflation figure.

definition: Policy rate less latest annual consumer price inflation. Published only when both inputs sit inside an 18-month window.
